name: Mini Glazed Meatloaves with Mashed Potatoes & Roasted Carrots

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince onions; place in a large bowl.
Add ground beef, eggs, milk, bread crumbs, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the onions. Mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
3 eggs
whole milk
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place ketchup, Dijon, and brown sugar in a small bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup ketchup
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Divide meatloaf mixture between 18 muffin cups and top with ketchup glaze. Place in the oven and bake until cooked through, 25-30 minutes.

Meanwhile, wash, peel, and medium dice potatoes. Transfer to a medium saucepan, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes.

Wash, trim, and peel carrots. Slice lengthwise into quarters. Place on a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper. Place in the oven and bake until golden and fork-tender, 12-15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 medium carrots
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the potatoes are done, drain, and return to the pan.
Add milk, butter, salt, and pepper to the potatoes. Mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
whole milk
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the meatloaves, roasted carrots, and mashed potatoes between plates. Enjoy!
